title: Whales and dolphins
examples: Do whales eat fish or plants?
What makes a whale different from a fish?
How big can the largest whale get?

explain.say: Whales and dolphins are special kinds of animals. They are mammals of the sea.
Because they are mammals, they need to breathe air like us. They cannot breathe underwater.
Whales and dolphins use a blowhole to breathe air. This is a special opening on their head.
When they swim, they swim deep down to find food. Then they swim up to the surface to breathe.
A concrete example is a dolphin surfacing. It blows a stream of air through its blowhole.
In real life, you see this when a whale breaches. It leaps out of the water to take a big breath.

faq.q: Do whales breathe air or water?
faq.a: Whales and dolphins are mammals, so they must breathe air. They use their blowholes to breathe the air we breathe.

faq.q: What is the blowhole used for?
faq.a: The blowhole is the special opening they use to breathe air from the surface. It is located on top of their head.
asks: What is that hole on top?

faq.a: Whales are warm-blooded, which means they keep their own body temperature warm. This is a key sign that they are mammals.
asks: Do they get warm from the sun?
Are they like fish or like us?

faq.a: Whales can dive very deep into the ocean to find food. They must save enough air for when they reach the surface.
asks: How long can they stay underwater?
What do they do when they dive deep?

faq.a: No, sea mammals also include manatees and sea otters. Whales and dolphins are just two types of them.
asks: What else lives in the ocean like them?

facts: Whales and dolphins are mammals, meaning they breathe air.
They use a blowhole, which is an opening on their head.
Because they are warm-blooded, they keep their bodies warm.
They must surface regularly to breathe air.

quiz.say: Whales and dolphins are mammals, so they must breathe:
quiz.why: Mammals, including whales, are warm-blooded and must breathe air using their lungs.

wrong.0: This is tempting because air has oxygen, but oxygen is a gas, not the thing they breathe.
wrong.1: This is tempting because it is part of their body, but blubber is fat, not something for breathing.
wrong.3: This is tempting because they live in the ocean, but fish breathe water.

quiz.say: What is the special opening whales use to breathe?
quiz.why: The blowhole is the specific opening on their head that allows them to release air.

wrong.0: This is tempting because they use it for eating, but it is not the main breathing opening.
wrong.1: This is tempting because fish use them, but whales are mammals, not fish.
wrong.3: This is tempting because it is a breathing hole, but that is a term for land animals.

quiz.say: If a creature is warm-blooded, it means it:
quiz.why: Being warm-blooded means the animal generates and keeps its own body heat, like humans do.

wrong.0: This is tempting because their diet is important, but it does not describe temperature control.
wrong.1: This is tempting because some warm things are in warm water, but it is not the definition of warm-blooded.
wrong.3: This is tempting because swimming uses energy, but it does not control body temperature.
